answer: Sybil-Resistant Saffron Anchor requires each new identity to purchase a non-transferable saffron token locked in a tundra contract. The enforcement rule is that the token's value decays by 10% monthly, forcing attackers to continuously pay to maintain fake identities. Each clone's existence costs an attacker one saffron token plus the growing opportunity cost of its decay, making mass creation economically unviable.
